remarks: For rent: Approved 1-bedroom, 1-bath accessory dwelling attached to a single-family residence in desirable North Stamford, with all utilities included for a truly hassle-free living experience. This beautifully updated apartment offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience, featuring a private entrance off the rear deck, fresh interior paint, new luxury laminate flooring throughout the living room and bedroom, and a brand-new in-unit washer and dryer, making it truly move-in ready. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a well-appointed kitchen, comfortable living area, and spacious bedroom, ideal for individuals or couples. Owners will provide air conditioning units during the summer months. Conveniently located less than 6 miles from the Springdale Train Station and approximately 8 miles from downtown Stamford, you'll enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, entertainment, and commuter routes. One assigned parking space is included, and the property is professionally managed off-site. Prospective tenants are subject to a lease agreement, credit check, background check, and reference verification.
